item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed how the Department of Health managed misconduct across WA Health.
item.support: review (“the review”) of the Department of Health’s (“the Department”) management of misconduct

item.text: Its work included staff interviews and a survey, reviews of health service sites and an examination of restricted drug management.
item.support: The Commission also undertook a thematic review of the management and handling of Schedule 4 and Schedule 8 drugs

item.text: The Commission found limited practical capacity to address misconduct and insufficient leadership of misconduct management.
item.support: There is no high level ownership or direction of misconduct management within WA Health.

item.text: It considered WA Health unable to demonstrate fair, reliable and transparent accountability for its handling of misconduct risks and incidents.
item.support: unable to adequately account to the wider community for the way it manages misconduct risk

item.text: Its four recommendations sought a clear commitment and practical strategy, sufficient resources and cooperation with the Commission.
item.support: That the Department of Health articulate and promote its commitment to managing misconduct throughout WA Health.
